statement: Provide a coincident constraint that joins two constraint points, or a point and a curve or its extension, with a Multiple option and an autoconstrain option, shown on the constraint bar as a small square marker.
superiority: Constraints solved live at 60 fps with explicit DOF count.

acceptance.sketch: Two line endpoints constrained: after dragging one, the other endpoint follows with distance 0 within 1e-9; point-on-curve keeps point on the curve.

notes: Verified against help page "GCCOINCIDENT (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-54069D14-97BF-42C5-8B42-9087A18C49D8 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers ConstraintSolve, ConstraintsPanel; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Provide a collinear constraint that makes two or more lines, polyline segments or similar linear objects lie along one common line.

acceptance.sketch: Two lines collinear: after moving one endpoint both remain on a common line within 1e-9.

notes: Verified against help page "GCCOLLINEAR (Command)". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide a concentric constraint that gives two circles, arcs or ellipses the same center point.

acceptance.sketch: Two circles concentric: moving one moves the center of the other equal within 1e-9.

notes: Verified against help page "GCCONCENTRIC (Command)". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide a fix constraint that locks either a single constraint point or a whole object in place so it cannot be moved.

acceptance.sketch: Fixed line cannot be dragged; remaining DOF reduced by 4; dimension tries to move fixed object fail with message.

notes: Verified against help page "GCFIX (Command)". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide a parallel constraint that keeps selected lines or linear segments parallel to one another.

acceptance.sketch: After parallel constraint and rotating line A by 30: line B direction changes to 30 within 1e-9.

notes: Verified against help page "GCPARALLEL (Command)". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide a perpendicular constraint that holds selected lines at 90 degrees to each other, even when they do not intersect.

acceptance.sketch: Perpendicular lines remain at 90 degrees after stretching, angle error under 1e-9.

notes: Verified against help page "GCPERPENDICULAR (Command)". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide a horizontal constraint that forces a line, or two constraint points, to run level with the X direction of the active UCS.

acceptance.sketch: Horizontal line has equal Y at both ends; rotating UCS changes meaning with UCS.

notes: Verified against help page "GCHORIZONTAL (Command)". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide a vertical constraint that forces a line, or two constraint points, to run level with the Y direction of the active UCS.

acceptance.sketch: Vertical line has equal X at both ends after editing.

notes: Verified against help page "GCVERTICAL (Command)". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide a tangent constraint that keeps two curves (lines, polyline segments, circles, arcs, ellipses) tangent to each other or to each other's extensions, without requiring them to physically touch.

acceptance.sketch: Circle tangent to line: distance center to line equals radius within 1e-9 after moving the line.

notes: Verified against help page "GCTANGENT (Command)". Corrected: Spline is not a valid tangent constraint object on the page; spline continuity belongs to GCSMOOTH. | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide a smooth constraint that keeps a spline continuous with G2 continuity to another spline, line, arc or polyline segment, making their endpoints coincident.

acceptance.sketch: Spline joined to line has curvature continuity at junction measured within 1e-6.

notes: Verified against help page "GCSMOOTH (Command)". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide a symmetric constraint that makes two selected objects or two points mirror each other about a chosen symmetry line.

acceptance.sketch: Points P and Q symmetric about axis: midpoint lies on the axis and PQ perpendicular within 1e-9.

notes: Verified against help page "GCSYMMETRIC (Command)". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide an equal constraint that gives selected lines the same length and selected circles or arcs the same radius, with a Multiple option.

acceptance.sketch: Two lines equal: after changing one length the other equals it within 1e-9; two circles equal radii.

notes: Verified against help page "GCEQUAL (Command)". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide dimensional constraints (linear, horizontal, vertical, aligned) that control distances and lengths through named parameters, each created in a dynamic or annotational form.

acceptance.sketch: d1=20 horizontal constraint: line length 20 exact; editing the parameter to 30 re-solves length within 1e-9.

notes: Verified against help page "DIMCONSTRAINT (Command)". Corrected: Form is dynamic or annotational, not static/dynamic; ref widened to DIMCONSTRAINT, which dispatches to DCLINEAR, DCHORIZONTAL, DCVERTICAL and DCALIGNED. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-E64A038C-0928-4E8E-BC60-356FDF86CFFB ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-615063B5-1E07-4756-A367-64C743BF3810 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-F7ED2587-8F25-4770-BD13-C7C95456E707 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide an angular dimensional constraint for the angle between two lines or polyline segments, the sweep of an arc, or three points, driven by a named parameter.

notes: Verified against help page "DCANGULAR (Command)". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide radius and diameter dimensional constraints that fix the size of circles and arcs through named parameters.

statement: Provide a command that converts selected associative dimensions into dimensional constraints, ignoring non-dimension objects in the selection.

acceptance.sketch: Convert a linear dimension: new constraint holds measured value and updates geometry on edit.

notes: Verified against help page "DCCONVERT (Command)". Corrected: Page documents only dimension-to-constraint conversion; no reverse conversion back to dimensions is documented (dynamic/annotational form switching is done in the Properties palette). statement: Provide a command that strips every geometric and dimensional constraint from a selection set and reports how many were removed.

acceptance.sketch: After DELCONSTRAINT objects move freely and the constraint bar shows none.

notes: Verified against help page "DELCONSTRAINT (Command)". | prior app hint: cand2 app registers ConstraintDelete; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Provide a command to show, hide or reset constraint bars for selected objects, with the types shown governed by CONSTRAINTBARMODE and the bar transparency set in constraint settings.

acceptance.sketch: CONSTRAINTBARMODE 0 hides all; bar icons show per constraint on objects.

notes: Verified against help page "CONSTRAINTBAR (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-6C6BEE02-35E8-4D0D-920E-E72B4E5BA2DD ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-AA5BEC92-FEC7-4FD7-9C3D-0F4A91F80B2B | prior app hint: cand2 app registers ConstraintsShow; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Provide a Constraint Settings dialog with Geometric, Dimensional and AutoConstrain tabs covering constraint inference, constraint bar display, constraint types, priority order and tolerances.

acceptance.sketch: Turn on infer constraints: drawing a line near horizontal adds a horizontal constraint within the angle tolerance.

notes: Verified against help page "CONSTRAINTSETTINGS (Command)". statement: Provide a command that applies suitable geometric constraints across a selection automatically, driven by the type list, priority order and distance and angle tolerances of the AutoConstrain settings.

acceptance.sketch: Rectangle drawn sloppy: after AUTOCONSTRAIN it has 4 coincident, 2 horizontal, 2 vertical constraints.

notes: Verified against help page "AUTOCONSTRAIN (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-61E10B9D-71D5-45E7-AF97-F0884B75930D | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide a Parameters Manager palette that lists dimensional-constraint parameters, reference parameters and user variables, each editable by name or by an expression using arithmetic operators, trig and math functions (sqrt, sin, abs, min) and the constants Pi and e.

source.ref: About Controlling Geometry With the Parameters Manager

superiority: Parameter sheet with units and export to CSV.

acceptance.sketch: d1=2*d2 parameter driven: set d2=5 gives d1=10; expression error shown.

notes: Verified against help page "About Controlling Geometry With the Parameters Manager". Corrected: Lookup tables are not part of the drawing Parameters Manager page (only block-editor user parameters); DELCONSTRAINT is unrelated to it; add separate rows if wanted. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-9A7DB9D7-A577-45DB-B176-F1F2297814D6 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1BCED000-B1B5-4C54-BC8D-E410AB10FBA7 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Refuse any constraint that would overconstrain the geometry, and offer reference parameters (driven constraints shown in parentheses) that report a measurement without controlling the geometry.

acceptance.sketch: Add a fourth dimension on a fully dimensioned rectangle: reference dimension (parenthesized) not driving.

notes: Verified against help page "About Parametric Drawing and Constraints". Corrected: AutoCAD prevents overconstrained conditions rather than detecting and warning about conflicts; reference parameters are documented on the Applying Dimensional Constraints page. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-F7ED2587-8F25-4770-BD13-C7C95456E707 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Track whether geometry is unconstrained, underconstrained or fully constrained (a full set including at least one fix constraint), and let users relax or delete constraints temporarily to make edits.

acceptance.sketch: Under constrained shape drags; fully constrained shape fixed; unsolvable edit rolls back with message.

notes: Verified against help page "About Parametric Drawing and Constraints". Corrected: AutoCAD documents three constraint states and relax/delete behavior, not a degrees-of-freedom readout or a solver-failure feedback UI. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-9DFC2C49-2B41-4B01-8897-086468B4FA26 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers ConstraintSolve; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Allow geometric and dimensional constraints inside the Block Editor, where dimensional constraints converted to constraint parameters (BCPARAMETER) expose editable custom properties and grips on the block reference.

source.ref: About Adding Constraints to Dynamic Blocks

notes: Verified against help page "About Adding Constraints to Dynamic Blocks". Corrected: Wording narrowed: constraint parameters, not plain constraints, become block properties. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-E836E290-7608-4D78-8869-DDFEDB8C9EFC ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-619C5C87-5D0C-4AF3-B107-6823B7D95B8D | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Solve large constraint systems (1000+ constraints) responsively and deterministically without numerical drift.

acceptance.sketch: 1000-constraint sketch drag completes at over 30 fps; solution residuals under 1e-9.

notes: UNVERIFIED: Non-functional performance target; no help page documents solver limits or ordering. Closest page is the parametric drawing overview. | prior app hint: cand2 app registers ConstraintSolve; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Persist the constraint network as associative actions and dependencies in the DWG (AcDbAssocNetwork holding AcDbAssocActions) and restore it on load.

acceptance.sketch: Open with constraints intact and re-solve unchanged; unknown constraint types kept as data.

statement: Allow constraints to be applied to individual polyline segments as if they were separate objects, using endpoints, segment midpoints and arc-segment centers as constraint points.

acceptance.sketch: Polyline segment horizontal with segment length constraint.

Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-3208AA9B-A1D0-4541-B045-3D81CF6336C2 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.
